stage: S2/S5 independent teacher-currentbody structural and forward-kinematic mapping audit
scope: No environment creation/reset/step, no training, no surgeries, no tracked-file edits. Only model loading/compilation, scratch forward kinematics and Jacobians.
measurements: Exact compiled joints/actuators/bodies/geoms/options; qpos0 and native key0 FK; central finite differences at epsilon=1e-6 rad against point Jacobians for all real-body hinges; per-leg anatomical anchor offsets and segment lengths; no assumed scalar angle correspondence.
tolerance: Within-model Jacobian/central-difference maximum absolute error <1e-7 native length/rad; cross-model comparisons are descriptive, not pass gates or biological mapping proof.
platform_boundary: Retain current complete body; feeding/choice and full platform freeze precede any surgery. Missing articulation is reported, not repaired here.
